data.exact_reserve_text: During 2021 the syndicate released prior year reserves of $33.1m (2020: $16.5m). The syndicate's Marine, Property and Specialty Lines divisions all produced large releases on the 2019 underwriting year while Cyber & Executive Risk produced a net release of $4.4m despite an increase in ransomware claims activity on the 2020 underwriting year. The syndicate has taken action in the Property division to remediate selected areas of the account, including the entering into a 90% Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) of the divisions Engineering classes in March 2021, contributing to the release of $9.0m in the division.

data.standardized_narrative: At the 2021 year end the syndicate reported an opening gross claims outstanding balance of $949.5m (comparative 2020). During 2021 the syndicate recorded prior year reserve releases of $33.1m, driven by favourable claims development across multiple divisions (notably Marine, Property and Specialty Lines), reserve management actions including a 90% Loss Portfolio Transfer in Engineering (contributing $9.0m of the releases) and the subsiding of pandemic-related spikes. One division (Political, Accident & Contingency) saw adverse prior-year movement. The net effect was an overall release, reducing previously held margins in reserves and contributing to the improved combined ratio in 2021.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from the Balance Sheet (gross claims outstanding comparative column, USD). Prior year development taken from the Managing Agent narrative and divisional table which explicitly state 'released prior year reserves of $33.1m' (treated as GROSS). Where division table shows parentheses (e.g. (2.0) for Political) that was interpreted as adverse movement (strengthening). Amounts are in the report currency (USD). No explicit GROSS 'movement in prior year claims outstanding' reconciliation line was present showing a single gross total; the narrative and divisional breakdown were used as authoritative. Claims development triangle present in technical provisions is provided in percentage and ultimate rows; however the report's 'Total ultimate losses' row is a current estimate summary (excluded per instructions) so a numeric gross development triangle (period-by-period cumulative amounts) was not extracted; therefore _claims_triangle is marked 'none'.
